scope: Studio OS — Experience mode templates, rail CSS, workspace canvases, workbench context column, plus horizontal-overflow root-cause sweep.

horizontal_overflow_root_causes.failure_mode: fixed min-height 80vh from .studio-os-iframe class with no height clamp; iframe content can force horizontal scroll inside main column on narrow viewports; no wrapper to clamp inner padding
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.fix_strategy: wrap iframe in .rmc-studio-experience-iframe-shell that sets width:100%, max-width:100%, height clamp(420px,60vh,720px), 1px hairline border + radius via tokens

horizontal_overflow_root_causes.failure_mode: long rail labels (e.g. 'Communication style packs', 'Dashboard visual packs', 'Portal shell layouts') have no word-break/overflow-wrap; rail width is constrained to min(12.5rem,100%) by workspace grid; labels can spill outside grid track on languages with longer translations, causing horizontal scroll
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.fix_strategy: add overflow-wrap:anywhere to rail link text, and word-break:break-word fallback. Move to new Experience-scoped CSS file

horizontal_overflow_root_causes.failure_mode: context tool link labels (long translations) wrap to multiple lines and may overflow horizontally when context column min-width:0 isn't enforced on inner <li><a>; risk of inline-flow widening if a single long word lands
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.fix_strategy: add overflow-wrap:anywhere on context list links; ensure inner cards have min-width:0

horizontal_overflow_root_causes.failure_mode: rail anchor has no word-break; if `item.label` is a long unsplittable token (e.g. URL or long translated phrase) the rail track widens and forces parent horizontal scroll
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.fix_strategy: extend studio-experience-mode.css to set overflow-wrap:anywhere on a.experience-rail-link

horizontal_overflow_root_causes.failure_mode: shared rail-link rule does not declare overflow-wrap or word-break, so long unsplittable labels push rail wider than its grid track
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.fix_strategy: Do NOT mutate this shared file (used by 4 modes — would change other agents' output). Layer Experience-only overrides in a NEW file static/css/studio-experience-mode.css. Other agents may apply same fix to their rails.
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.owner: agent2 (Experience-only), with coordinator-task flag for Output/Automation/Launch rails

horizontal_overflow_root_causes.failure_mode: container-fluid forces 100% width but px-md-2 (8px each side) plus the children's own padding can sum to overflow on narrow viewports when nested grids inside don't have min-width:0 at every level. Not Experience-specific but inherits down.
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.fix_strategy: Coordinator task — confirm shell .rmc-shell-content-grid has overflow-x:clip (it does in studio-shell-layout.css:58). No further shell change needed; risk lives downstream in mode templates.
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.owner: coordinator (no action needed, documented for confirmation only)

horizontal_overflow_root_causes.selector_or_tag: .studio-os__right (Studio OS right column outside the workspace 3-col)
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.failure_mode: overflow:auto + overflow-x:clip — this is the legacy Studio OS right column, not the Experience workspace context. Not a bug per se (the clip is intentional). Documented for completeness.
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.fix_strategy: no-op — outside Experience ownership; not a sticky+overflow:hidden combo

horizontal_overflow_root_causes.failure_mode: inline width/height (rem, not px so fluid-safe) plus dynamic background. Inline style here is unavoidable for tenant-data swatches but the values are rem-based, so no horizontal cut.
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.fix_strategy: no-op — width is rem and small; would only register on scan_inline_style_off_token. Not an overflow risk.
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.owner: no action (subpage outside Experience workspace ownership)

horizontal_overflow_root_causes.selector_or_tag: missing — context column currently shows only tool links
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.failure_mode: context column is under-built; needs token-property summary, contrast badge, version history, audit feed. When populated, must enforce min-width:0 and overflow-wrap to avoid OF-3.
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.fix_strategy: rebuild context column to render theme_token_values / theme_contrast_report / studio_version_history / studio_audit, with overflow-wrap:anywhere on token values and code fragments

horizontal_overflow_root_causes.failure_mode: theme_colors_content.html is dense (palette, form, preview cards) and may itself contain rows/cards that don't clamp inside the workspace main column on 1366px
horizontal_overflow_root_causes.fix_strategy: wrap include in <div class="rmc-studio-experience-canvas-clamp"> with max-width:100%, min-width:0 to firewall the include from widening the column

existing_routes: studio_os:preview (POST endpoint; delegates to siteconfig.preview_from_form for experience mode)
gaps: No live-preview iframe surface in Experience workspace — user has no in-shell view of theme applied to a tenant page (only the legacy Customizer/Theme & Colors form). studio_preview is POST-only, not a render URL.
studio_role_preview_entries context is populated but never rendered inside Experience workspace (Launch mode renders it via launch_studio_role_preview_pane.html).
No dummy/fake preview buttons in current Experience templates — clean baseline. New preview pane MUST hit real role-preview URLs or render honest 'Preview unavailable' state.
live_preview_model.plan: Build experience_live_preview_pane.html with: (a) responsive iframe wrapper (aspect-ratio 16/10, width 100%); (b) role/audience <select> driven by studio_role_preview_entries; (c) state badges using theme_contrast_report.status + theme_recent_change_meta; (d) honest 'Preview unavailable' empty state when no entries. Wire iframe src to the selected role URL — these are real tenant-scoped dashboards on the same host.
